verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a SaaS email service like Gmail, so the axis applies. The evidence documents a REST API, push notifications, IMAP/SMTP access and Workspace add-ons. These are developer building blocks or adjacent integration surfaces, not an official command-line tool, and nothing in the pack mentions a first-party Gmail CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
